question.generated:
Which SQL query below correctly performs an inner join to retrieve the author's first name, last name, book title, royalty rate, and title ID, while ensuring that all matching records from both tables are included in the result set?

```sql
SELECT a.au_fname, a.au_lname, b.title, b.royalty, ta.title_id
FROM authors a
INNER JOIN titleauthor ta ON a.au_id = ta.au_id
INNER JOIN books b ON ta.title_id = b.title_id;
```
